entities.summary: David Charles Coon is a Canadian conservationist and politician who has served as leader of the Green Party of New Brunswick since 2012 and as a Member of the Legislative Assembly of New Brunswick since 2014, elected three times in Fredericton South and a fourth time to represent the newly constituted riding of Fredericton-Lincoln.
